name: vedara-vscode
description: Private, offline AI coding with local models via Ollama: Tab completion, chat, reviewed multi-file edits and one-click undo. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.

commands.title: Vedara: Fix Bugs in Selected Code

enumDescriptions: Ollama, on this machine or another one.
Any OpenAI-compatible server: vLLM, llama.cpp (llama-server), LM Studio, or a team GPU server.
vedara.serverType.markdownDescription: Which kind of model server Vedara talks to. An organization policy file can set this for everyone; see the README.

vedara.ollamaEndpoint.description: Base URL of the Ollama server, used when Server Type is ollama.

vedara.openaiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server, including `/v1`, used when Server Type is `openai`. Set an API key, if the server needs one, with **Vedara: Set Server API Key**.

vedara.openaiAutocompleteBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for Tab completion when the Tab model runs on its own OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM and llama.cpp serve one model per server). Leave empty to use **Openai Base Url** for both.

vedara.autocompleteModel.markdownDescription: Local Ollama model for inline Tab (fill-in-the-middle) completion. Use a small FIM-trained **base** coder: `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b-base` (default, ~1 GB), `qwen2.5-coder:0.5b-base` for low-memory machines, or `qwen2.5-coder:3b-base` for 16 GB+. Instruction-tuned chat models are poor at FIM.

vedara.chatModel.markdownDescription: Local Ollama model for chat and SEARCH/REPLACE edits. Suggested (2026): `qwen3-coder:30b` (Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, 32 GB+), `qwen3.6:27b` (Qwen3.6-27B, 32 GB+), `devstral-small-2:24b` (Devstral Small 2, 24 GB+), `gpt-oss:20b` (16 GB+). The default `qwen2.5-coder:7b` runs on 8 GB. Run **Vedara: Recommend Local Models** for a pairing based on this machine and what is installed.

vedara.debounceMs.description: Typing debounce delay in milliseconds before dispatching inference.

vedara.maxPrefixChars.description: Maximum characters before cursor included in FIM prompt.

vedara.maxSuffixChars.description: Maximum characters after cursor included in FIM prompt.

vedara.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for inline code completion (0.0 to 1.0).

vedara.contextLength.markdownDescription: Context window (in tokens) for chat and Tab completion. It must hold the current file, recent conversation and the reply. Larger values use more GPU memory; lower it if `ollama ps` shows the model running partly on the CPU.

vedara.checkpoints.enabled.description: Before every AI edit, snapshot the git workspace (including untracked files and unsaved editors) under refs/ai-checkpoints/. Never moves HEAD or touches the staging area. Restore via 'Vedara: Show Checkpoints'.

vedara.checkpoints.maxPerBranch.description: Number of AI checkpoints kept per branch; older checkpoint refs are deleted.

vedara.nextEdit.enabled.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** Predict your next edit near the cursor with a local Zeta 2 model (`zed-industries/zeta-2`) served by Ollama, using your recent edits as context. The prediction appears as a highlighted change: `Tab` accepts, `Esc` dismisses.

vedara.nextEdit.model.markdownDescription: Ollama model tag for next-edit prediction. Must be a Zeta 2 GGUF (the prompt format is model-specific). Pull it once with `ollama pull hf.co/bartowski/zed-industries_zeta-2-GGUF:Q4_K_M` (about 5 GB; Q8_0 is also available).

vedara.nextEdit.debounceMs.description: Pause after typing before requesting a next-edit prediction (milliseconds).
